status: SCOPED STATIC N703 PEER REVIEW; three source flows confirmed with qualifications, no native installer/OS acceptance

flows.source_proven: New package plist embeds requested VERSION, but native launcher checks only executable existence of fixed per-user venv/bin/python. Existing executable immediately execv python -m spacr.qt; no version comparison or validation against SPACRPackageVersion. Package postinstall creates command symlink only; first-user helper invoked only if executable missing.
flows.conditional_consequence: If a newer bundle is installed, per-user Python remains executable and imports older spaCR, that older package can launch. Source does not establish which historical package a user actually installed, imported identity, LaunchServices selection or observed OS runtime.
flows.preservation_requirement: Do not replace this with unconditional pinned reinstall: existing test185-201 specifies older launcher must use newer existing runtime, preserving no downgrade. Test read only; not run.

flows.source_proven: Missing executable launches osascript Terminal activation/do script helper. Helper invokes Unix installer without consent-collected/answer flags, then opens application. Unix installer asks three optional choices via shell read only if consent not collected, stdin TTY and not dry-run. Native package postinstall does no user runtime setup.
flows.qualification: Current app questions can occur in Terminal after native package UI, not proof every execution asks: existing runtime skips helper; collected consent/non-TTY/dry-run avoid read. All questions inside native installer window is a requested future UI/lifecycle contract, not current implemented behavior. OS authorization UI remains separate.

flows.source_proven: Frozen Debian builder installs absolute /usr/bin/spacr wrapper exec /opt/spacr/spacr, but shared desktop entry Exec=spacr names bare command. Online Unix installer creates launcher bound to VENV_DIR/bin/python and desktop Exec=$LAUNCHER; its immediate launch calls that launcher directly.
flows.qualification: Bare Exec leaves selection to desktop PATH/command resolution; earlier alternate launcher is a possible source-level route, not measured order or selected executable on actual OS. Default online HOME-based paths are absolute and avoid ordinary PATH competition for that entry. --launcher-dir109-112/XDG_BIN_HOME288 are used without absolute normalization, so absolute-path guarantee is conditional on those inputs. Correct runtime import identity still needs independent validation; launch path alone does not prove imported version.

what_is_not_reviewed: All27 archived source/test files or native acceptance evidence
Installer signing/artifact identity or installed package byte identity
OS launch order, permissions, TTY resolution or actual installer GUI
Owner full N703 acceptance matrix/change-string list
future_native_acceptance_proposals: On actual macOS, newer requested package plus older existing runtime must upgrade before launch and bind imported source/version; older package must never downgrade newer verified runtime.
Native graphical setup keeps app options/progress/errors/cancel/retry inside installer window through verified activation; do not silently suppress Terminal questions as equivalent acceptance.

On Linux with competing launchers, record desktop environment PATH/selected executable/imported code identity. Validate desktop entry points to owned intended launcher; include explicit custom-path behavior.
